The counter staff were friendly and cheerful, but the restaurant's queuing system is extremely slow. I had a reservation, but arrived and had to wait over an hour. That day, I had an appointment and had other errands to run, so I asked how many people were in line. They said five, and I thought it wouldn't take more than an hour. In the end, I waited almost two and a half hours. The restaurant should manage its queuing system better. It was so slow that I couldn't do anything else. It was a huge waste of time!

Honestly, I just went in hoping to fix my teeth a bit… didn’t think it would turn out this good.

The result is super natural, not fake at all. I did ceramic veneers and it really changed my whole smile. The dentist is quite young and comes across very confident — almost bold at first 😅 — but honestly, the skills speak for themselves. Super precise, very detail-oriented, and really knows what they’re doing.

Now I feel way more confident when I smile. Like… I don’t have to hide it anymore.

For me, totally worth the price.

Every time I make an appointment, they call to reschedule, change the date, or change the time without any clarity. Even though the staff called to confirm, the appointment was confirmed through the platform. But when the actual day arrives, they say there's no appointment, the doctor hasn't arrived, or the appointment has been made incorrectly. It's like there's no communication within the team.

This problem didn't just happen once or twice, but so many times that I feel like the clinic has no systematic management. Crucially, every time it's rescheduled, I have to rearrange everything, including travel and work. Everything has to be adjusted accordingly, which is truly frustrating.

The staff then claim it's a "back-office error." To be honest,
the back-office problem isn't the customer's responsibility.
Customers just need to show up on time for their appointment — not to find out there's no appointment or the doctor isn't available.

I'd like the clinic to seriously improve its systems and procedures, because the current situation reflects extreme unprofessionalism and directly impacts patients.

Please help address this issue urgently and make appointments more systematic, so that customers don't have to worry every time about whether an appointment will actually be made.

Initially, the service was excellent. The clinic never called to reschedule appointments. On the day of my appointment, I usually waited around 10-20 minutes before being seen. Currently, the reception desk calls to reschedule very frequently. Even arriving on time, I have to wait 50 minutes or more, sometimes even an hour. I personally think the doctor and assistants work very quickly. I kindly request the clinic to improve its scheduling system, as some customers have other appointments to attend to.

I had clear liner treatment from this clinic- big mistake!  Nothing was explained fully when I started & I had a lot of discomfort. The dentist immediately pulled out 2 of my teeth when starting treatment. I assumed this must be normal & necessary. On getting 2 other opinions from other dentists I visited because I was very unhappy with the attitude & experience with this clinic they were shocked that my teeth were removed as it was not necessary. In trying to get my scan records transferred to a new dental clinic they wanted  to charge me 1,000 THB. The new clinic confirms the treatment I have been  receiving is incorrect.
Stay away from this clinic!

text: Yes, the doctor gave good advice.

The counter staff were friendly and helpful. The clinic was clean and offered free water.
However, the doctor and assistant weren't very good. The treatment seemed unplanned, rushed, and lacked explanation and guidance. They were abrupt and just went ahead with the procedure without any explanation. The tartar removal was extremely quick but not clean. I'd like to know if the doctor who performed the procedure is the same person as the dentist listed on the sign, but after checking, they seem to be different individuals. I hope the clinic addresses this issue. When we use their services, we expect peace of mind and trustworthiness, especially since we're paying for the service. We want treatment that justifies the price.

The front desk staff were good, but the doctor in the treatment room was terrible. The chubby female orthodontist (I'm not sure if she's actually an orthodontist) didn't do any X-rays or anything. She just had me lie down and open my mouth to check the teeth that needed fillings, and then told me to leave. Is this the correct examination procedure? And she spoke rudely; she used polite language like "ka" and "kha" but spoke harshly and rudely. The atmosphere of the clinic was good overall, except for the doctor. She rushed the process, and the examination itself was awful.
I recommend that you change the assistants and doctors if you want to continue operating. Customers want good service. The front desk staff was very nice though. I was planning to get treatment here because of a celebrity review. I think you should consider changing the assistants and doctors so the clinic will attract more patients.

I had braces done at this clinic. The service was terrible, a 1 out of 10. The worst part was the doctor and the assistant. The counter staff were nice though. The assistant, not the doctor, attached the braces, and they were chatting and playing around, completely ignoring the patient. As a result, the braces weren't securely attached; three brackets came loose, even though I hadn't eaten anything hard. They came off very easily. Think carefully before considering this clinic. When I told the doctor about the loose brackets, she was unhappy and spoke very rudely, showing no respect for the patient. She blamed me for not chewing properly, even though the braces weren't securely attached. She held my mouth open while chatting with her assistant, completely ignoring me. When I left to pay, I overheard the doctor badmouthing other patients behind my back. Is this acceptable service? Should I ever use their services again? Definitely not. Also, the sign outside the clinic shows the name of a different doctor, but they are not the actual practitioners. Think carefully before deciding whether or not to go here.
Anyone thinking of coming here... run away! I took my girlfriend to the dentist, but the doctor's words... I made her walk out immediately. Anyone considering coming here... think carefully.
